name: MLIR-Spec-150
description: Hand-authored NL→MLIR pairs for arith+func+memref dialects; 38/44/18% easy/medium/hard mix; all reference MLIR verify-clean under mlir-opt --verify-diagnostics.

distribution.name: test.jsonl
distribution.description: One JSON record per line for the MLIR-Spec-150 dataset. Generated 1-to-1 from the per-record JSON files in the same directory.

recordSet.name: records
recordSet.description: One MLIR prompt/reference pair per record.

field.name: mlir
field.description: Reference MLIR that verifies under mlir-opt/iree-compile.

field.name: dialect
field.description: MLIR dialect of the reference program.

rai:dataCollection: Hand-authored by the submitting author against the target MLIR dialect's ODS.
rai:dataBiases: Author-curated: prompts reflect the submitting author's mental model of the target dialect; may under-represent op combinations not present in the spec examples.
No human-subject data; no PII; no demographic bias dimensions apply.
rai:dataLimitations: Verify-valid pass-rate measures structural validity under mlir-opt/iree-compile, not functional correctness. Programs that pass the gate may still compute the wrong function.
Small n (30-200 prompts per dataset) yields CI half-widths of ~3-10pp at p=0.5.
rai:useCases: Evaluating NL→MLIR generation systems (constrained or unconstrained) under a verifier-based pass-rate metric.
rai:excludedUseCases: Evaluating functional correctness without an additional lowering + execution harness.
Training or fine-tuning production code-generation models without a separate held-out corpus.

extra.sampling: Author-curated (single author), covering the 12 named ops in scope.
